svg.text: Tang Nano 20K + AD9226 + ILI9341 (+ ESP32-S3 reserved) - wiring layout, view from the component side
Generated from hardware/gen_wiring_sch.py (same tables as the KiCad schematic and adc_test.cst). Not to exact scale.
P2 header faces the Tang, +5V row at the top
Tang mounted HDMI end UP: J5 = left row (ESP side), J6 = right row (ADC side). Pin text "20 · IO52" = header pin 20, FPGA pin 52.
AD9226 P2 order is from the seller photo - VERIFY before powering. Measure the module's 3V3 pad (logic must be 3.3 V).
TFT: LED pin bridged to VCC on the TFT side; SDO and touch pins unconnected. microSD slot on the Tang must stay EMPTY.
Grey pins = not connected (76/86 BL616, 49 LCD backlight, 51/54/55/56 audio amp, 72 spare).
